title: SemPurify: Semantics-Aware Data Purification for Black-box Backdoor Defense
title_zh: SemPurify：面向黑盒后门防御的语义感知数据净化方法

paragraphs.en: 总结：SemPurify是首个面向黑盒后门防御的语义感知数据净化框架，利用多级语义引导T2I修复，在清除后门的同时有效保留图像细节与语义信息。 Backdoor attacks have emerged as a critical security threat in machine learning, where adversaries embed triggers within poisoned training samples to manipulate a model's predictions on targeted inputs while leaving its general behavior unaffected. This stealthy nature makes backdoor attacks difficult to detect, as the model functions normally until activated by a specific malicious trigger. Current purification-based defenses use image transformations (e.g., blurring) to disrupt trigger patterns but often degrade image quality. Even with advanced restoration techniques like diffusion models, these approaches can still alter visual or semantic information, reducing utility for downstream tasks. To address this, we propose the first semantics-aware data purification framework for black-box backdoor defense, SemPurify, which explicitly incorporates multi-level semantics (i.e., low-level semantic embeddings and high-level image tags) within a text-to-image (T2I) framework to guide image restoration during purification. Using this semantic information, the T2I model subsequently refines the transformed samples, helping preserve visual details and semantic information during restoration. Extensive experiments spanning multiple backdoor scenarios, i.e., classification models, CLIP-style encoders, and generative models, demonstrate that SemPurify reliably removes backdoors while effectively preserving semantic information for downstream tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：SemPurify是首个面向黑盒后门防御的语义感知数据净化框架，利用多级语义引导T2I修复，在清除后门的同时有效保留图像细节与语义信息。 后门攻击已成为机器学习中一个关键的安全威胁，攻击者在被投毒的训练样本中嵌入触发器，以操纵模型对特定目标输入的预测，同时不影响模型的正常行为。 这种隐蔽性使得后门攻击难以检测，因为模型在被特定恶意触发器激活之前一直正常运行。 当前基于净化的防御方法使用图像变换（例如模糊）来破坏触发器模式，但往往会降低图像质量。 即使采用扩散模型等先进的修复技术，这些方法仍可能改变视觉或语义信息，降低其在下游任务中的可用性。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了首个面向黑盒后门防御的语义感知数据净化框架SemPurify，它在文生图（T2I）框架中显式地引入多级语义（即低级语义嵌入和高级图像标签），以在净化过程中引导图像修复。 利用这些语义信息，T2I模型随后对变换后的样本进行精修，帮助在修复过程中保留视觉细节和语义信息。 涵盖多种后门场景（即分类模型、CLIP风格编码器和生成模型）的大量实验表明，SemPurify能够可靠地清除后门，同时有效保留下游任务所需的语义信息。
